name: design-patterns
title_zh: 新模块开工前先翻这页 Rust 模式清单
tagline_zh: 写 CLI 过滤器时，newtype、Builder、RAII、Trait Object、状态机，五种模式直接套。
tagline_en: Newtype, Builder, RAII, Trait Objects, State Machine—pre-cut for CLI filters. Skip the textbook, start coding.
desc_en: Rust design patterns for RTK. Newtype, Builder, RAII, Trait Objects, State Machine. Applied to CLI filter modules. Use when designing new modules or refactoring existing ones.
why_zh: 把模式按 CLI 场景裁剪过，每个都配了过滤器模块的落地姿势，比看通用教程少绕三步。
why_en: Patterns are tailored to CLI filter contexts with concrete examples, saving you three detours versus generic guides.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 CLI 过滤器模块的设计与重构；不教 Rust 语法，不含并发或异步模式，超出此域请另寻他册。
limit_en: Only for CLI filter module design/refactor; no Rust syntax, no concurrency/async patterns. Outside that, look elsewhere.
title_en: Rust pattern cheat sheet for CLI filter modules
